findings.text: public/live/readme.md:38 and :40 still tell the reader to put a link card's `text` on its card ("Put its preview on /live/: ... `"text":"Three steps…"`") and edit it with `{"title","text"}`. Cards no longer show `text`, so a fresh agent following this gets an empty card; rewrite both to use the `preview` list (or `description`). Row 20 (`part-card` with `text`) needs one clause saying the text now shows only on the card's own page.

public/live/readme.md:44 and public/live/doc/page-features.md:22,57-58,69 say "previews has no delta". That is now partly stale: a `preview` list takes deltas (readme.md:275). Update them to point at the new row, and keep only the `previews()` wall as no-delta.

The task folder has no landing note. `live-r11/` holds only requirements.md and shots. Ask 13 (preview lines up with the title) has no proof shot, and the LivePage.test #12 result is not recorded. Add a short done note with the test count and one shot, such as a card with an icon at 1200.

public/live/LivePage.js:102 gives every LivePage an own `preview` property that hides core Page's `preview(nav)` method. No other LivePage code calls it, but a page.js subclass of LivePage that overrides `preview(nav)` for a card, as /web/nav/wall describes, would now be shadowed by the instance property. The requirements flag this as a decision, so it is worth a line in public/live/readme.md "Watch out".

LivePage.Preview (LivePage.js:190) draws the link-page description through `P.meta_of(url)`, which makes its own fetch per card. It is cached by `metas`, so it is fine, but the "link card shows its page's own preview list" gap (readme.md:275, ⬜) remains the main unbuilt piece.
shots/plan-400.png matches asks 2, 4 and 7: the title and preview line up, an empty preview falls back to the description, and the chevron sits in the bottom-right corner.

log.msg: Result: worktree/live-r11. Every LivePage card and page has a `preview` List (LiveContent.own_list, LivePage constructor); LivePage.Preview draws it (else description, else the page's own description for a link); card = title + preview; chevron in the bottom-right corner (LivePage.chevron); code above the link layer and edge to edge on a phone; tables stack at 400 (LivePage.label_tables); preview aligned with the title. Also: tab() no longer marks picks as children (ten 404s on /live/demos/tabs-page/ gone). Checks: LivePage.test 35 pass (#12 card, link card, page preview lists, link description); headless shots in shots/ at 400 and 1200, no page errors (only the worktree-only page-work.json / tasks.json 404s).
